prompt_en: An environmental portrait captures a layered photographic moment inside a roofed harbor repair booth at rainy blue hour. A fictional adult woman reveals an object to its waiting owner. Use the attached portrait as guidance for her visible face and hair: a dark chin-length bob with wispy fringe, rounded cheeks, brown eyes and softly shaped lips. She stands beside a waist-high wooden workbench, wearing a cream cotton shirt with an open collar and rolled sleeves, and dark work trousers. Her right palm supports the underside of an upright pale glazed cup, with fingers curved around its base; her bent right elbow holds it just above the bench. Her left fingertips peel loose brown wrapping paper away from the cup, exposing a thin mended seam. She turns a faint half-smile toward an adult customer in profile at the open doorway, whose hands rest on the far end of the workbench. A small radio and neatly coiled wire sit on the back shelf; wet pier boards and moored boats recede through the doorway. The intimate gesture carries the picture. Frame her from mid-thigh upward at chest height in a three-quarter view, including her face, both forearms, the cup and the customer's profile. A warm task bulb above the bench lights her cheek and the cup against cool blue harbor light. Fine irregular film grain is plainly visible in the flat blue doorway shadows and cream wall midtones. A narrow red-orange edge halo follows the brightest task-bulb outline against the dark roof beam. Highlights on her cheek, the cup glaze and crumpled paper roll gently into pale tones, retaining smooth gradients and material texture. Face and revealed seam lead the eye, then the owner's listening posture and rainy harbor depth.
